from common import *
import pandas as pd

if __name__=='__main__':
    register_adapter(__file__)
    import qlib
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    proof=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference.json')
    assert proof['all_new_reference_annual_predictions_exact']
    preds={c['session']:pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0] for c in proof['components']}
    class FrozenSignal:
        def __init__(self,session):self.pred=preds[session]
        def predict(self,dataset,segment='test'):return self.pred
    # Reuse formal evaluation math/filters; inference is separately frozen and verified.
    ev._load_model=lambda session:FrozenSignal(session)
    ev._build_dataset=lambda *a,**kw:None
    cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'))
    regime=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5/configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv'
    result=ev.evaluate_multi_horizon(cfg,[(c['session'],c['seed']) for c in proof['components']],['all'],horizons=[5],st_daily=PROVIDER.parent/'st_daily.csv',min_listing_days=60,min_count=20,regime_monthly=ev.load_regime_monthly(regime),regime_pools=['all'],head_k=[3],exclude_limit_up=True,min_amount=10000000.)
    assert result['data_version']=='2026-11-03'
    result['stability_provenance']={'inference':fingerprint(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference.json'),'role':'reconstructed old-label five-seed H20, first repeat selected before returns','historical_exactness':proof['all_old_historical_pickle_sha_equal']}
    out=BASE/'metrics'/f'{PREFIX}-old-model.json';write(out,result)
    print(json.dumps(result['pools']['all']['ensemble']['head']['3']['5'],indent=2))
